name: RevLink Sidecar
notes: Nano product profile. Guarded AccessPort writes and guarded deletion of files inside maps/ and datalog/ are compiled in; both runtime consents are separate switches and both default to locked.

silicon.rejectMessage: This build targets the ESP32-P4-NANO, which uses pre-v3 P4 silicon. The board you connected reports revision v{rev}, which is the Dev Kit's v3.x silicon. ESP-IDF treats these as incompatible targets, so this image will not boot on it.
